heading: INT. COUNTY JAIL - ATTORNEY VISITING BOOTH - DAY

units.text: INT. COUNTY JAIL - ATTORNEY VISITING BOOTH - DAY
A narrow cinderblock booth split by a thick pane of scratched glass.
A steel counter on either side, a black wall phone on each.
Fluorescent hum.
A clock on the wall behind the prisoner's side reads 2:14.
ATTORNEY ROSALINDA FAIRWEATHER-KIM, 40s, in a navy suit with a legal pad open on the counter, sits on a bolted stool.
Across the glass sits her client, ERNESTINE VOSS-ADEBAYO, 60s, in an orange jumpsuit, hands folded, back straight as a rail.
They each hold a receiver.
You look tired.
units.name: ROSALINDA

units.text: I'm sixty-three. I look tired.
units.name: ERNESTINE

units.text: Did they feed you?
units.name: ROSALINDA

units.text: A sandwich. I won't characterize it.
units.name: ERNESTINE

units.text: Ernestine, I need you to listen.
units.name: ROSALINDA

units.text: I'm listening.
units.name: ERNESTINE

units.text: The prosecutor offered a plea.
units.name: ROSALINDA

units.text: No.
units.name: ERNESTINE

units.text: You haven't heard it.
units.name: ROSALINDA

units.text: I've heard the word plea. That's enough.
units.name: ERNESTINE

units.text: Five years. Instead of fifteen.
units.name: ROSALINDA

units.text: I did not take the money.
units.name: ERNESTINE

units.text: I know.
units.name: ROSALINDA

units.text: Then why should I say I did?
units.name: ERNESTINE

units.text: Because a jury might say you did.
units.name: ROSALINDA

units.text: Let them.
units.name: ERNESTINE

units.text: They've got the ledger. They've got your signature on it.
units.name: ROSALINDA

units.text: My signature on a forged ledger.
units.name: ERNESTINE

units.text: We don't have proof of forged.
units.name: ROSALINDA

units.text: Then find it.
units.name: ERNESTINE

units.text: I have been looking for six months.
units.name: ROSALINDA

units.text: Look harder.
units.name: ERNESTINE

units.text: Ernestine. I need you to understand what fifteen years means.
units.name: ROSALINDA

units.text: I'll be seventy-eight.
units.name: ERNESTINE

units.text: Yes.
units.name: ROSALINDA

units.text: And if I plead, I'll be sixty-eight, with a record, and everyone in the church will whisper.
units.name: ERNESTINE

units.text: That's one way to see it.
units.name: ROSALINDA

units.text: It is the way I see it.
units.name: ERNESTINE

units.text: She smooths the front of her jumpsuit, once, with the flat of her hand.
Across the glass, the lawyer watches the gesture, then lowers her pen.
All right. Then we go to trial.
units.name: ROSALINDA

units.text: Thank you.
units.name: ERNESTINE

units.text: Don't thank me yet. I haven't won.
units.name: ROSALINDA

units.text: You haven't lost either.
units.name: ERNESTINE
